name: Ann Coulter
role: American conservative columnist, author and television commentator
summary: Conservative polemicist who opposes abortion, same-sex marriage and amnesty, wants far lower immigration, favours free-market health care and a flat tax, and rejects the case for human-caused global warming. She backed military tribunals and a hard line on terrorism in 2001-02, and defends Trump against the Russia investigation.

notes: Evidence is her own words: the book Resistance Is Futile (2018), columns on townhall.com and anncoulter.com (2005-2026) and CNN transcripts (2001-2014, via the MediaSum corpus). Themes searched: immigration, abortion, marriage, religion, courts, guns, speech, taxes, unions, welfare, foreign policy and the UN, executive power, federalism. Most statements stay null: she has no stated position on them in the sources read (monarchy, secession, class theory, voting systems, most economy-structure statements). Her foreign-policy record mixes supporting the Iraq invasion and US intervention in Latin America with opposing the 2026 Iran war and nation-building, so defensive-wars-only and humanitarian-intervention are left null. Her 2001 words on torture conflict with later ones, so it is null.
